description:
About the job




ESTAMOS CONTRATANDO

Especialista en Análisis de Ventas, Datos y Business Intelligence

Datos, Inteligencia de Negocio y Control Financiero




 Departamento

 Finanzas / Operaciones / TI

 Rango salarial

 A negociar en entrevista + vales de despensa + prestaciones de ley

 

Sobre 916 Foods

En 916 Foods somos un operador estratégico de franquicias Wendy's en Estados Unidos. Actualmente administramos más de 86 unidades en Texas y Florida, con una visión clara: crecer con excelencia operativa, disciplina financiera y toma de decisiones basada en datos.

Desde 2021 hemos consolidado una plataforma sólida de operación multi-unidad en el sector QSR y nos encontramos en una etapa activa de expansión hacia nuevos mercados en EE. UU.

Buscamos talento analítico de alto desempeño que quiera participar directamente en la optimización financiera de una operación internacional en crecimiento acelerado.




El reto del puesto

Asegurar la correcta extracción, integridad, consolidación y almacenamiento de los datos transaccionales (POS) y operativos de más de 86 tiendas. Serás responsable de diseñar las reglas de extracción, estructurar la base de datos y transformar esa información en reportes financieros y operativos altamente confiables — proveyendo visibilidad en tiempo real para la toma de decisiones, control de fugas de dinero y análisis de rendimiento contra presupuestos e históricos.




Lo que harás

Gobierno, extracción e integridad de datos (Data Engineering & Cloud)

• Monitorear que los procesos automáticos de extracción de datos desde los POS funcionen diariamente sin errores hacia la nube consolidadora.

• Diseñar y configurar nuevas reglas de extracción y transformación de datos (ETL/ELT) al integrar nuevas plataformas o variables.

• Auditar la calidad del dato: garantizar que la información en la nube coincida al 100% con los cierres de tienda.




Auditoría de ingresos y control financiero

• Cruzar las ventas registradas en el POS contra los depósitos bancarios reales y pasarelas de pago.

• Identificar discrepancias financieras (fugas de dinero, contracargos, comisiones no identificadas) y reportar la causa raíz.




Inteligencia de negocio y análisis de ventas (BI & Analytics)

• Diseñar, automatizar y mantener dashboards ejecutivos y operativos: ventas, ticket promedio, menu-mix, horas pico, canales (Delivery vs. Drive-thru).

• Desarrollar reportes comparativos contra años anteriores, presupuestos/forecast y otros indicadores clave.




Soporte a la toma de decisiones

• Traducir datos complejos en hallazgos (insights) sencillos y accionables para Directores de Operaciones y Administradores.

• Garantizar la entrega puntual de reportes diarios, semanales y mensuales bajo estrictos estándares de calidad.




Lo que buscamos en ti

Formación y experiencia

• Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Ciencia de Datos, Tecnologías de la Información, Actuaría, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas con enfoque tecnológico o afines.

• 3 a 4 años de experiencia en Análisis de Datos, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering o Análisis Financiero masivo.

• Indispensable: experiencia en industrias de alto volumen transaccional — Franquicias, QSR, Retail o E-commerce.




Habilidades técnicas

• SQL avanzado (indispensable): queries complejos, limpieza y estructuración de datos.

• Power BI — dominio experto en diseño de páneles funcionales y automatizados.

• Nube (AWS, Azure o Google Cloud) — conocimiento básico/intermedio, manejo de data warehouses.

• Excel avanzado — tablas dinámicas, Power Query y fórmulas financieras complejas.

• Inglés fluido — lectura de documentación técnica, correos y llamadas.




Habilidades y actitudes clave

• Atención extrema al detalle: tolerancia cero al error en reportes financieros y datos operativos.

• Alta confiabilidad y ética — manejo de información sensible y confidencial.

• Aprendizaje autodidacta: proactividad para entender nuevos sistemas por cuenta propia.

• Orientación a resultados: entregar valor real mediante los datos, no solo gráficas o tablas.




¿Por qué unirte a 916 Foods?

• Impacto directo en decisiones financieras y operativas de una cadena en expansión activa.

• Exposición a herramientas de datos y nube de clase mundial, con datos transaccionales reales de alto volumen.

• Esquema híbrido: presencial con 1 día de home office.

• Prestaciones de ley y vales de despensa.




¿Te interesa? Postúlate y sé parte del crecimiento de 916 Foods.

description:
About the job

Every deal ProximityParks evaluates rests on a logistics argument that has to hold up under scrutiny: how much a tenant saves by operating from an urban last mile location, how the building actually works for their operation, and what layout the space can support. The Logistics Intelligence Analyst is the person who builds that evidence. This role owns the last mile business cases, the logistics and demographic analysis per deal, and the recurring analytics that management relies on to make operational and investment decisions.

If this role were absent for a week, the logistics analysis behind the deals in progress would stall: investment committee sessions would lose the quantified savings case, and commercial proposals would go out without a layout or a savings figure to support them. Continuity matters as much as output here — every analysis must be documented so that it survives beyond the person who built it.

Day to day, the Analyst works with the VP of Operations, supports Investments with the logistics inputs for underwriting and investment committee, provides Commercial and Leasing with business cases and layouts for prospective tenants, coordinates with Property Management on property operating data and site conditions, and supplies Marketing with validated logistics data for external materials. The role also travels occasionally to the properties to validate conditions in the field.




Key Responsibilities




1. Logistics Data Analytics

Build and maintain the recurring logistics analyses that support operational and investment decisions across the portfolio.
Consolidate and validate logistics, demographic, and property operating data sets, resolving inconsistencies before the data is used in any deliverable.
Translate data into clear findings and recommendations that a non-technical audience can act on.

2. Last Mile Business Cases

Develop last mile transportation savings business cases per deal, quantifying the operational benefit of a ProximityParks location versus the tenant's current setup.
Prepare the logistics and demographic report for each deal under evaluation, delivering it within the timeline required by the investment committee cycle.
Document assumptions, cost structures, and sensitivity ranges so that every result can be defended and audited.

3. Warehouse Layout & Space Planning

Produce last mile warehouse layouts to support tenant proposals, defining dock positions, maneuvering areas, and internal material flows.
Size storage and handling capacity at a conceptual level based on the tenant's operating profile.
Validate every layout against the physical constraints of the property before it is shared with Commercial.

4. Logistics Project Management

Manage logistics-related projects from scope definition through delivery, tracking milestones, dependencies, and vendors involved.
Conduct field visits to properties to validate on-site conditions, including camera positioning and framing for access control.
Escalate deviations in scope, cost, or schedule to the VP of Operations with a recommended course of action.

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

Support Investments with the logistics inputs required for underwriting and investment committee sessions.
Provide Commercial and Leasing with business cases and layouts for prospective tenants, adjusting the analysis as negotiations evolve.
Coordinate with Property Management on property operating data and site conditions, and supply Marketing with validated logistics data for external materials.

6. Reporting & Documentation

Deliver the recurring logistics analytics reports to internal stakeholders on the agreed calendar.
Maintain a documented repository of methodologies, data sources, and deliverables so that any analysis can be reproduced by another team member.
Report progress, findings, and risks to the VP of Operations on a regular basis.

5. Success Measures (KPIs)

100% of recurring logistics analytics reports delivered on schedule.
Business cases delivered within the agreed timeline for every investment committee session.
Accuracy of last mile savings estimates versus actual results, within the defined tolerance range.
100% of analyses documented and reproducible by another team member.
Zero rework on layouts delivered to Commercial due to dimensioning errors.




Qualifications




Education

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field (required).

Experience

2 to 4 years of experience in logistics, last mile operations, operations consulting, or industrial real estate (required).
Experience preparing quantitative business cases for decision-making audiences (required).

Technical knowledge & tools

Advanced Excel and data analytics — data consolidation, modeling, and visualization (required).
Working knowledge of transportation cost structures and last mile operating models (required).
Understanding of last mile warehouse design and material handling systems at a conceptual level (required).
AutoCAD for layouts and space planning (is a plus).
Use of AI tools such as Claude to accelerate analysis and documentation (is a plus).

description:
About the job

About the Role

We are looking for a personable, technically capable Software Demo & Customer Onboarding Specialist to help roofing contractors successfully evaluate, adopt, and use our roofing CRM platform.




This is not a high-pressure sales position. Your job is to understand how a roofing company operates, demonstrate how the software can improve its workflow, and then help new customers successfully transition from their existing CRM or business systems onto our platform.




You will work directly with roofing company owners, managers, sales teams, office staff, and administrators. Once a company signs up, you will help guide them through setup, data migration, training, launch, and ongoing support.




The ideal candidate is comfortable on Zoom, learns software quickly, communicates clearly, and can patiently guide customers who range from highly technical to people who simply want someone to show them exactly what to click.




Key Responsibilities




Software Demonstrations

Conduct live Zoom/video demonstrations for roofing companies interested in the CRM.
Learn enough about each company's current process to tailor the demonstration to their needs.
Clearly demonstrate features, workflows, integrations, reporting, automation, and other capabilities.
Answer technical and operational questions during demonstrations.
Document questions or technical issues that need to be escalated to the development team.
Follow a standardized demo process while still making each presentation conversational and relevant.




Customer Onboarding




Once a roofing company becomes a customer, you will help take them from "we signed up" to "our team is successfully using the system."

Conduct onboarding and kickoff meetings.
Gather information about the customer's existing CRM and business processes.
Create and manage an onboarding checklist for each account.
Configure company information, users, permissions, workflows, pipelines, and settings.
Coordinate integrations with other software and services.
Help customers understand how their existing processes translate into the new CRM.
Train owners, administrators, salespeople, production teams, and office staff.
Conduct follow-up training sessions when necessary.
Track onboarding progress and make sure customers do not stall during implementation.




CRM Migration




Many customers will already be using another roofing or construction CRM. You will help coordinate their migration, including:

Understanding their existing CRM structure.
Identifying what information needs to be migrated.
Coordinating exports of customer, lead, job, contact, and other relevant data.
Reviewing data for completeness before migration.
Working with our technical team when more complex migrations are required.
Verifying migrated information with the customer.
Helping customers transition workflows from their previous CRM into the new system.
Making sure the customer understands what will and will not transfer before migration begins.




Technical expectation:




You do not need to be a software developer, but you should be technically comfortable and able to learn how CRM databases, integrations, imports/exports, and workflows operate.




Customer Support

After launch, you will also be one of the people customers can rely on for help. This includes:

Answering software questions through email, chat, phone, and video calls.
Troubleshooting basic user issues.
Helping customers configure or modify their accounts.
Creating short instructional videos or screen recordings when helpful.
Maintaining FAQs and internal documentation.
Identifying recurring customer problems that should be addressed through training or product improvements.
Escalating bugs and advanced technical issues to the appropriate team.
Following up with customers until their issue is resolved.




What We're Looking For




Required:

Excellent spoken and written English.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based business owners and executives.
Comfortable conducting live software demonstrations over Zoom or similar platforms.
Strong computer and general technical skills.
Ability to learn new software quickly.
Experience with CRM, SaaS, project management, or business software.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
Patient and professional when helping less-technical customers.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment.
Ability to work primarily during U.S. business hours.




Strongly Preferred:




Experience with one or more of the following:

Roofing or construction industry
Roofing CRM software
SaaS customer success
Software implementation
Customer onboarding
CRM migration
Technical customer support
Software training
Account management




Especially valuable platforms:

AccuLynx
JobNimbus
ServiceTitan
Roofr
Salesforce
HubSpot
GoHighLevel
CompanyCam
Similar systems




The Person Who Will Excel in This Position




You don't have to know everything about roofing or our CRM on day one. You do need to be someone who can learn a system thoroughly enough to confidently teach it to someone else.




"We're currently using another CRM. We have thousands of customers and jobs in there. Show me how your system works, explain how we're going to move everything over, and help me get my team using it."




Your job is to confidently guide that customer through the entire process.




Success in This Role

Quality and professionalism of software demonstrations.
Demo-to-onboarding handoff.
Speed of customer implementation.
Percentage of customers successfully completing onboarding.
Customer adoption and usage.
Migration accuracy.
Customer satisfaction.
Support response and resolution time.
Ability to independently resolve customer questions.
Quality of documentation and training materials.
Reduction in customers requiring repeated support for the same issues.




What matters most:




We care more about your ability to communicate, learn technology, solve problems, and work well with customers than having a specific degree.

description:
About the job

Resumen General de la Posición

La Gerencia Comercial y Desarrollo de la Galería es una posición estratégica y estructural dentro de la galería. Su objetivo principal es diseñar, liderar y ejecutar el sistema comercial de la empresa, asegurando que todos los canales de adquisición de clientes, digitales, presenciales y relacionales,

operen con claridad, consistencia y alto estándar. Este rol combina alto criterio, capacidad operativa, ejecutivas y habilidades sociales de alto nivel. Es una posición pensada para alguien que entiende que el crecimiento comercial no depende únicamente de vender más, sino de construir procesos sólidos, mejorar la experiencia del cliente, profesionalizar el seguimiento y desarrollar relaciones duraderas. La persona que ocupe este puesto trabajará de manera directa con Dirección General y con Dirección Comercial & Growth, funcionando como un eje articulador entre estrategia, ejecución y equipo. Tendrá contacto directo con clientes, acompañará procesos comerciales relevantes y será responsable de elevar el estándar del área comercial en su conjunto.







RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE







DESARROLLO DE PROTOCOLO COMERCIAL DE GALERÍA Y LIDERAZGO DE EVENTOS

• Diseñar y estandarizar protocolos de atención y seguimiento para visitas, citas y operación comercial de las galerías físicas.

• Coordinar y diseñar el protocolo de los eventos de la galería, así como una experiencia de cliente profesional, cálida y alineada con el posicionamiento de la galería, incluyendo seguimiento post-visita para maximizar conversión y relaciones de largo plazo.

• Responsables de dar la presentación inicial de eventos, ejecutar el protocolo, y dar visitas guiadas en exposiciones , aperturas, eventos, y activaciones relevantes al frente de públicos amplios y sofisticados y relevantes, definiendo objetivos y dando seguimiento a las oportunidades generadas.

• Participar en eventos, ferias y viajes cuando el desarrollo comercial lo requiera.




COORDINACIÓN DE ESTRATEGIA COMERCIAL MULTICANAL

• Optimizar integralmente el sistema comercial de la galería, traduciendo objetivos en planes claros y ejecutables para mejorar adquisición, seguimiento y conversión de clientes.

• Analizar el desempeño de los distintos canales comerciales y asegurar la alineación entre estrategia, operación, inventario y postventa.

• Coordinar, junto con la agencia y Operaciones, la estrategia comercial del canal digital: contenido, campañas, paid media y generación de leads.

• Liderar la atención, calificación y seguimiento de prospectos provenientes de Instagram, WhatsApp y otros canales, asegurando rapidez, calidad y consistencia.

• Diseñar y perfeccionar protocolos comerciales y, posteriormente, capacitar y supervisar a un perfil junior de responding para escalar el canal.




CLIENT RELATIONS Y APOYO A DIRECCIÓN COMERCIAL

• Participar directamente en citas, visitas privadas, entregas de obra y experiencias con clientes.

• Acompañar a Dirección Comercial & Growth en el desarrollo y seguimiento de clientes, coleccionistas, prospectos y relaciones estratégicas.

• Construir relaciones de largo plazo y funcionar como soporte estructural para convertir oportunidades en procesos comerciales ordenados y accionables.

• Mantener actualizado el pipeline comercial, dando seguimiento documentado a oportunidades, acuerdos y pendientes, así como apoyar en investigación y preparación de materiales comerciales.

Las funciones específicas se desarrollan con mayor detalle en un anexo operativo que se comparte conforme avanza el proceso de reclutamiento.




PERFIL Y REQUISITOS

• Excelente comunicación verbal y escrita, con trato profesional y seguridad para relacionarse con distintos perfiles de clientes.

• Alta capacidad de organización, seguimiento, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

• Criterio, discreción, sensibilidad social y excelentes habilidades interpersonales.

• Experiencia en posiciones comerciales, desarrollo de negocio, gestión de clientes y/o implementación de procesos comerciales.

• Experiencia directa en atención y seguimiento de clientes. Se valorará experiencia en arte, industrias creativas, cultura, lujo, hospitality o servicios de alto valor.

• Inglés mínimo B2 indispensable.

• Disponibilidad para horarios flexibles, eventos, citas y viajes ocasionales.

• Afinidad e interés genuino por el arte, la cultura y los entornos creativos.




PROPUESTA ECONÓMICA 

• Compensación: $32,000 - $40,000 MXN mensuales + prestaciones de ley + esquema de comisiones y variables por resultados.

• Modalidad: Presencial con flexibilidad operativa y un día de home office semanal después del periodo inicial de capacitación.

• Jornada: Martes a sábado. Descanso domingo y lunes.

• Horario ordinario: 9:00 a 18:00 hrs., con flexibilidad basada en resultados. Por la naturaleza de la posición, se requiere disponibilidad ocasional para aperturas, eventos, ferias y citas con clientes fuera del horario habitual.

• Desarrollo profesional: Capacitación continua en formación comercial, industria del arte, herramientas y procesos internos.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Stripe implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Stripe's products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken.
2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

The Business Development Representative (BDR), LATAM is responsible for driving pipeline development and supporting new business growth across Latin America. Based in Mexico and working remotely, this role works in close alignment with the regional Sales organization while reporting into the Marketing team and partnering closely with the LATAM Marketing Manager.

The BDR serves as a critical link between Marketing and Sales by evaluating inbound leads, identifying and qualifying prospective opportunities, executing outbound prospecting campaigns, and scheduling meetings that create qualified sales conversations. Success in this role is measured by the ability to generate and qualify pipeline, accelerate lead progression, improve conversion rates, and create meaningful engagement opportunities for ACI's New Business sales teams.

- Execute targeted outbound prospecting campaigns aligned with regional sales priorities and account-based marketing initiatives.

- Leverage AI-powered sales, research, and productivity tools to scale prospecting activities, identify buying signals, prioritize opportunities, personalize outreach, automate administrative tasks, and increase the effectiveness of pipeline generation efforts while adhering to ACI security, privacy, and governance standards.

- Build and manage prospect lists in collaboration with regional sales and marketing teams.

- Support lead nurturing activities and ensure timely follow-up on marketing-generated leads.

- Maintain accurate lead, contact, activity, and opportunity records within Salesforce and other sales and marketing platforms.

- Monitor lead progression and work closely with sales teams to improve conversion rates and pipeline velocity.

- Provide feedback to Marketing regarding campaign effectiveness, lead quality, messaging, and market trends.

- Track and report on key business development metrics, including outreach activity, meetings generated, qualified opportunities, and pipeline contribution.

- Perform other duties as assigned.

- Understand and adhere to all Corporate Policies, including but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.




Qualifications (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)




- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent professional experience.

- 2-5 years of experience in business development, sales development, lead generation, inside sales, or related B2B sales roles.

- Experience supporting enterprise sales organizations.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Results-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to achieve activity and pipeline goals.




Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Competencies)




- Experience within payments, banking, fintech, software, SaaS, or technology industries.

- Experience supporting Latin American markets.

- Knowledge of Salesforce CRM.

- Experience using HubSpot, Demandbase, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar prospecting and marketing technologies.

- Familiarity with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs.

- Experience using AI-powered sales and business development platforms to enhance prospecting, account research, customer engagement, and pipeline development.

- Remote/telecommuter position based in Mexico.

- Qualified meetings generated.

ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer.




Important Notice About Recruitment Scams




Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

description:
About the job

ABOUT THE ROLE 




House of YO is a connectivity and distribution business with compute layered on top. We sell mobile plans, data, top-ups and YOYO$ rewards to prepaid users in the United States and Mexico, through an app.

Almost everything we sell happens inside that app. Getting the user back into it is this role. You own Braze and everything that goes out of it: mobile push, in-app messages, content cards and SMS. Onboarding, activation, top-up reminders, re-engagement, win-back.

YOlanda is our AI concierge. She runs the conversation once the user is inside. You run everything before that. The push that brings someone back on day three, the in-app that explains a plan change, the content card that surfaces a YOYO$ balance worth spending. Where the two meet, the handoff has to be clean. The message sets an expectation and YOlanda meets it on the other side of the tap.

Most of our users are on prepaid plans and count every dollar. A message that wastes their attention costs us the permission to send the next one. Sending less and converting more is the job.

You will not manage anyone. You will be in the dashboard every day.




Who this is for

You have sent millions of push notifications and you still read every one before it goes. You can open a Canvas and see where users fall out of it. You would rather run the test than win the argument about the copy. You know the difference between a message that works and a message that annoys, and you know the second one is expensive.

You are relentless. The first version is never the one that stays live.




Location: Remote, global Work format: Remote, full time




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the lifecycle map and build it in Canvas Flow — onboarding, activation, top-up reminders, re-engagement, win-back and churn saves.
Run the native mobile channels (push, in-app, content cards) and use SMS where it earns its cost. Set the frequency policy: caps, quiet hours and control groups.
Write Liquid and build custom in-app messages in HTML/CSS that render on old Android and new iPhone alike.
Own deep linking and pull real-time data with Connected Content so balances, prices and offers are always current at send time.
Ship every campaign in Spanish and English, written to the same standard — not translated.
Run A/B and multivariate tests, then report conversions and revenue inside a defined window, not open rates alone.
Keep the workspace clean: naming conventions, segment hygiene and documentation the next person can read.



WHAT YOU NEED

3+ years running high-volume mobile engagement campaigns hands-on in Braze.
Mobile depth: iOS/Android push permissions, provisional push, deep link schemas, APNs and FCM.
Liquid you can write without a reference open, plus HTML/CSS for custom in-app messages.
The ability to read Braze reporting, set a meaningful conversion window and follow a cohort over time.
Bilingual Spanish and English, written to the same standard in both.
Care for the user at the other end — prepaid users count every dollar and every notification.



Nice to have: Braze Certified Marketing Specialist or Strategy Expert; SQL, Currents or a warehouse; CDP work (Segment, mParticle); attribution (Branch, AppsFlyer); telecoms, prepaid or fintech.

Top-notch products disrupting the world of the traditional media-services industry

With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

You’ll be the face and voice of Deel for our clients, both internally and externally. In this dynamic role, you’ll be responsible for onboarding clients and setting them up for durable relationships with Deel to enable long-term success. You will serve as our client’s trusted advisor by providing strategic guidance during the onboarding phase on operational and product-related issues. Simultaneously, you will be an internal advocate for clients with Deel by championing new products and capabilities to facilitate the expansion of each client’s business with Deel. You will facilitate on-time onboarding through project management of all stakeholders involved.

You are a passionate business builder at heart. You get energized by tackling complex, challenging, often ambiguous problems and driving real impact across a business. You are not afraid to get your hands dirty to deliver projects. You are a talented generalist at home, diving into data for insights, and confident in cross-functional project management with multiple stakeholders. Working with great people is a non-negotiable priority because you thrive in a highly collaborative, high-performance team. If that is you, join our team!

Responsibilities


Project Management: Plan, execute, and monitor the successful launch of our Global all-in-one Employee Management Platform Implementation for a diverse set of clients, ensuring timely completion .
Product Expertise: Become a Deel expert and a go-to resource for our customers and internal colleagues by deeply understanding our products/services, industry trends, and competitive landscape.
Communication & Presence: Communicate clearly, persuasively, and professionally with stakeholders, demonstrating confidence and credibility. Enable our customer base by understanding their use cases and aligning them with Deel’s best practices.
Problem Solving: Identify, analyze, and resolve complex problems creatively and resourcefully. Provide global payroll expertise to our customers and internal Deel peers, driving continuous improvement.

This is not a traditional librarian role. You will be responsible for aiding in defining, building, implementing, and maintaining what best-in-class DAM looks like within a complex, global production environment, which includes operating within and constantly assessing a scalable, efficient, and future-ready asset management model.




This role requires a proactive go-getter, who can own disparate workstreams in the system. You will also have incredible attention to detail, as the role requires a level of quality control across assets, metadata, and taxonomy.







RESPONSIBILITIES

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Product Support team ensures Stripe’s users receive fast, reliable, and high-quality support across Stripe’s growing suite of products. The team partners closely with cross-functional teams to solve complex issues, improve support workflows, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence and user experience.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a dynamic and forward-thinking leader with a passion for solving complex, global user issues, redefining what operational excellence looks like, and driving an AI-first culture. You will play a front-line role in helping some of Stripe's top users accelerate their growth and ensure an unmatched customer experience when dealing with Stripe.

In this role, you will recruit, manage, and develop a team of Operations Associates focused on user support. You will be responsible for driving team engagement and motivation through consistent feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. This includes developing and executing tactics that enable the team to reach its goals, using data and metrics to measure performance and continuously raise the bar. You'll be a strong fit if you have the grit to get things moving, a sharp operational mindset, and a genuine passion for developing the people around you.

Responsibilities


Recruit, manage, coach, and develop a team of in-office Operations Associates
Drive strong operational performance through operational rigor, process improvement, and hands-on coaching, balancing a strong users-first mindset with speed and innovation
Cultivate a "what got us here will not get us there" mindset through continuous identification of process improvements and AI-first thinking
Planning for the unplanned: apply a "see around the corners" approach to capacity management, ensuring strong oversight of volume and user trends while anticipating curveballs before they impact the user experience
Own on-the-floor tactics as well as strategic initiatives to deliver on the Enterprise Roadmap
Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members' performance
Be data-driven in your analysis of performance and in your decision making
Build an environment rooted in trust and transparency with the goal of creating a "talent hub" where people develop and thrive, representing a strong talent pipeline for the rest of the organization
Be a role model at work and in life, inspiring your team and peers to do things smarter and aim higher



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


At least 5+ years experience leading operations support teams
Experience working cross-functionally with multiple teams to deliver high impact initiatives
Experience in delivering weekly and monthly business metrics and reporting
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
An ability to partner effectively with internal stakeholders
Background of identifying and remediating quality gaps in team performance
Passion for process improvement, innovation and AI



Preferred Qualifications


Proven experience building and scaling teams, including hiring, developing, and retaining top talent
Strong operational background with hands-on experience launching new processes and delivering best-in-class service in a high-growth technology environment
Demonstrated ability to anticipate operational challenges, think around corners, and build proactive solutions before issues arise
Track record of driving continuous improvement and challenging the status quo — comfortable asking "what got us here, won't get us there"
AI fluency and an AI-first mindset: experience leveraging AI tools to drive operational efficiency, improve team performance, or enhance the customer experience
Ability to operate across both tactical and strategic levels — equally comfortable on the floor with the team and in the room shaping the roadmap
Strong data-driven decision making skills with experience using metrics to manage team performance and drive outcomes
Proven ability to build high-trust, high-engagement team cultures that serve as a talent pipeline for the broader organization



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Excellent phone communication skills with clear, professional spoken English tailored for U.S. client interactions.

Strong foundational knowledge of customer service excellence and direct sales best practices.
Comfort and agility working independently while collaborating effectively within a small, tight-knit team.

The Support Specialist I plays a pivotal role within our organization, acting as the front-line support and dedicated resource for employees of Paylocity's Spending Accounts and COBRA clients. Full-time

About the job

"To provide quantitative international marketing expertise to regional management in the analysis of pricing, forecasting, competitive intelligence, market segmentation, and targeted marketing utilizing advanced quantitative and computer modeling techniques.

Develops both division and regional planning and analyses via strategic analysis, forecasting, pricing, rate development, and market research, utilizing advanced computer modeling. Evaluates new business opportunities by interpreting competitive analysis and market intelligence, customer needs, and assessing competitor market position. Evaluates the revenue and volume impact of new international flight schedules, pricing changes, customer value analysis, competitor actions, and product promotions. Develops statistical reports to forecast, analyze, and track FedEx volumes and revenue by customer group, product, and country. Automates essential reports utilizing appropriate computer languages, relational databases or OLAP tools such as SAS, C, Cobol, HOLOS, or ESSBASE. Frequently updates manager or senior analyst project leader on progress of projects. Trains users as necessary to enable them to utilize the systems described above. Conducts analysis and develops proposals for strategic target pricing programs, prepares profitability analysis for large customer pricing requests and other exceptions to pricing guidelines using applicable target pricing process. Analyzes revenue and profit performance of pricing programs, large customers, market segments and service type, and provides analysis to support changes or to develop new programs. Develops, maintains and posts to appropriate websites the pricing policies and procedures and pricing training manuals, conducts the compliance and control analysis/reports and conducts regular pricing audits with field marketing and sales; provides timely and effective pricing administration support in order to minimize revenue leakage and/or lost revenue opportunities to acceptable levels as determined by executive management."

5-10 years of work experience in marketing or similar quantitative business analysis, or related fields. Bachelor's Degree/equivalent in Business, Finance, Marketing, Mathematics, Computer Science, or comparable analytical discipline; Masters degree preferred. Analytical skills, judgement & decision making skills, leadership skills, presentation skills . International and/or air freight industry experience preferred. Knowledge of basic marketing functions. About the job

The Musketeer is the face of Red Bull within the On Premise universe, combining deep beverage expertise, entrepreneurial thinking, and long-term partnerships with key decision-makers. Acting as a trusted advisor across premium On Premise accounts including nightclubs, bars, pubs, hotels, airports, events, concerts, and music festivals. They bring the brand to life through exceptional consumer experiences, strategic commercial execution, and innovative activations.

This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful relationships with some of the industry's most influential partners while shaping how consumers experience one of the world's most iconic brands. Their mission is to strengthen Red Bull's presence across the On Premise channel by ensuring best-in-class availability, visibility, and execution at every point of consumption, ultimately driving sustainable business growth and reinforcing Red Bull as the beverage of choice wherever consumers live the brand.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

“LIVING” THE RED BULL ON PREMISE CULTURE

Build and nurture “kindred spirits” inside strategic hotels (concierge, bar managers, beverage directors, F&B directors). Seen as a credible and knowledgeable person to know in the On Premise. Demonstrates that they are seen as a “Do it now” person by influential contacts, brilliant knowledge and leverage of all brand properties. Represent the brand with professionalism and deep understanding of the hospitality environment. Be perceived as a credible reference within the hotel sector, with strong presence and influence across F&B leadership teams.

COMMUNICATION

Deliver On Premise know-how adapted to each consumption point inside the hotel. Permanent teamwork with other Musketeers and communication with his Regional Manager. Develop relative industry relationships (key hospitality stakeholders, F&B leaders, concierge managers, event/wedding planners.)  that results in business building initiatives.

EVENT ACTIVATION

Ensure availability and premium High 5 execution around 3rd party and Red Bull events. Negotiate and execute, pro-actively searching for opportunities to implement creative elements that drive Red Bull’s brand image and to offset money. Negotiate premium presence and added-value elements. Identify and execute creative experiential opportunities. Corporate conferences & weddings all year long.

TERRITORY MANAGEMENT

Grow & protect On Premise accounts in the related region. Permanent analysis of the territory and account specific business to find opportunities and to drive distribution. Correct positioning of the Red Bull brand and the Red Bull product portfolio in the territory. Identification, care and continuously development of local and regional On Premise accounts by a proper Route Planning. Set volume goals with each account that includes execution against Red Bull KPI’s. Review business volume and all business building initiatives permanently. Drive cooperation with the local Distributor’s Sales Force in order to reach an adequate numeric distribution. Routinely perform Staff Education/Energizers to ensure brand understanding, perfect serve, and encourage optimum pricing.

ADMINISTRATION

Permanent optimization of all OP Tools (OP Knowledge Base, Infonet, CRM, Warehouse, POS …). Negotiate and implement commercial partnership agreements. Offset funds from financial contribution to added value. Fulfilment of report dead lines. Management of the local on-premise Budget. Bottom up planning and tracking of all marketing tools.

MARKET RESEARCH

Observation and reports of competitor activities. Identify hotel openings and strategic opportunities. Identification of EPC outlets.

ON PREMISE MARKETING

Implement the On Premise strategy for Hospitality. Maintain and utilize tools appropriately (Point of sale materials) to drive vertical growth. Ensure that all marketing tools are staged in the right accounts according to international on -premise guidelines. Engage and differentiate the brand through innovative support following the On Premise vision of bringing added value to our customers.

KEY PRIORITIES

Securing the fulfilling of all International and national On Premise guidelines and the execution standards to reach a vertical growth in their customers. Continuously tracking of results accordingly. High 5 Execution: Perfect Serve: Ensure a cold Red Bull can is given to consumer when ordered as part of a mixer or as a stand-alone beverage. Perfect Visibility: Stages perfect visibility in order to optimize sales. Consumption Activation: Sells in appropriate consumption activation tools and communication pieces. Right Price: Encourage the optimum price for Red Bull and Red Bull products in all managed accounts as per international guidelines. Menu placements: Ensures Red Bull products are listed as per international guidelines on each menu as a stand-alone beverage and as part of a long drink.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


Recent graduates (Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field).
Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
Excellent communication skills, active listening, and negotiation abilities.
High self-motivation and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.
Intermediate or advanced English.
Valid driver’s license.

We're a global, remote-first team headquartered in New York, combining deep insurance expertise with modern technology to build smarter, faster, and more transparent solutions for the healthcare industry.

About the job

V A C A N T E · T I E M P O C O M P L E T O




Coordinador(a) de Marketing

y Contenido Digital

Lidera de punta a punta la estrategia digital del Grupo: del guion a la publicación.




1 Datos generales

Puesto: Coordinador(a) de Marketing y Contenido Digital

Modalidad: Híbrida (presencial + remoto)
Jornada: Tiempo completo- lunes a viernes (40 hrs/semana)
Salario: $20,000 – $25,000 MXN mensuales, según experiencia
Perfil: Joven, creativo(a), nivel junior a medio (1–4 años de experiencia)




2 Misión del puesto

Diseñar, coordinar y ejecutar la estrategia de marketing y comercial de los diversos productos y marcas del Grupo,liderando de punta a punta la estrategia digital de creación de contenido — desde la planeación y el guion hasta la edición final y la publicación — con apoyo deseable en la publicidad digital del Grupo (Google Ads y pauta en redes), y apoyándose en herramientas de inteligencia artificial (LLMs) para multiplicar su productividad y la calidad de los entregables.




3 Alcances del puesto

▪ Estrategia de marketing y comercial de los distintos productos y unidades de negocio del Grupo.

▪ Coordinación integral de la estrategia digital: calendario editorial, líneas de contenido y presencia en redes sociales.

▪ Producción y edición de contenido audiovisual (reels, carruseles, videos cortos, gráficos) — función crítica del puesto.

▪ Publicidad digital (deseable): apoyo en campañas de Google Ads y pauta en redes sociales (Meta).

▪ Medición y reporte de resultados: alcance, engagement, crecimiento y conversión a leads/clientes.

▪ Interlocución directa con la Dirección para alinear el contenido con los objetivos comerciales.




4 Responsabilidades principales




MARKETING Y ESTRATEGIA COMERCIAL

▪ Diseñar e implementar el plan de marketing de cada producto/marca del Grupo, con objetivos y calendario.

▪ Proponer campañas, promociones y acciones comerciales para generar prospectos y ventas.

▪ Dar seguimiento a leads y prospectos de venta, a métricas comerciales y ajustar la estrategia con base en resultados.




ESTRATEGIA DIGITAL Y CREACIÓN DE CONTENIDO

▪ Construir y administrar el calendario editorial mensual de todas las cuentas del Grupo.

▪ Coordinar grabaciones, guiones y sesiones de contenido (organización de tiempos, locaciones y materiales).

▪ Redactar copies, guiones y piezas gráficas alineadas a la identidad de cada marca.




EDICIÓN DE CONTENIDO (FUNCIÓN CRÍTICA)

▪ Editar videos y reels con ritmo, subtítulos, cortes dinámicos y formato optimizado por plataforma.

▪ Diseñar piezas gráficas y carruseles (Canva o similar) listos para publicar.

▪ Garantizar un estándar de calidad y consistencia visual en todo el contenido publicado.




PUBLICIDAD DIGITAL Y PAUTA — GOOGLE ADS (DE SEABLE )

▪ Apoyar en la creación y optimización de campañas en Google Ads (búsqueda, display y/o YouTube) para los productos del Grupo.

▪ Apoyar en la pauta en Meta Ads (Instagram/Facebook) en conjunto con la estrategia orgánica.

▪ Reportar resultados de campañas cuando gestione pauta: CTR, costo por lead (CPL) y retorno de inversión (ROAS).




USO DE INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL (MUY DE SEABLE )

▪ Utilizar LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT u otros) para investigación, redacción de guiones, copies e ideación de campañas.

▪ Integrar herramientas de IA al flujo de producción y edición para acelerar entregables.




5 Perfil del candidato(a)




▪ Formación en Marketing, Comunicación, Diseño, Negocios o afín (titulado o pasante).

▪ 1 a 4 años de experiencia en marketing digital, manejo de redes y/o producción de contenido (se aceptan portafolios freelance).

▪ Dominio de herramientas de edición: CapCut, Premiere o similar; Canva y/o Suite Adobe.

▪ Manejo de Meta Business Suite, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn y programación de contenido.

▪ Deseable: conocimientos o experiencia en Google Ads y pauta digital; certificación de Google es un plus.

▪ Uso demostrable de LLMs / herramientas de IA en su trabajo (gran diferenciador).

▪ Portafolio o cuentas que demuestren contenido creado y editado por el candidato (requisito).

▪ Soft skills: creatividad, autonomía, organización, orientación a resultados y excelente redacción.




6 Indicadores de desempeño (KPIs)




▪ Cumplimiento del calendario editorial (≥ 90% de publicaciones en tiempo).

▪ Crecimiento mensual de alcance y seguidores en las cuentas del Grupo.

▪ Engagement (guardados, compartidos, comentarios) por pieza publicada.

▪ Leads o prospectos generados atribuibles a las acciones de marketing.

▪ Tiempo de entrega de ediciones (turnaround) y retrabajos por pieza.

▪ Desempeño de campañas de pauta (Google Ads / Meta): CTR, CPL y ROAS — aplicable si gestiona pauta.




7 Condiciones y esquema de contratación




▪ Salario de $20,000 a $25,000 MXN mensuales, según experiencia y portafolio.

▪ Jornada de 8 horas diarias, lunes a viernes (tiempo completo), prestaciones de ley, en esquema híbrido de Home Office con flexibilidad de horario.




Contactarnos a través del correo maguilar@hermosilloresendiz.com

• Capacidad para coordinar equipos y contratistas en campo.

🤝 Ambiente profesional, cercano y colaborativo.
